request.title: Title
request.noteRequired: Write the reason in the note box.
request.required: A title and at least one asset are required.
request.selfApproval: You requested this change, so another person has to decide on it.
request.approvedHint: Changes to the assets are covered from approval until the request is marked implemented.

urgency.label: Urgency
urgency.help: An emergency change can be implemented right after submitting. It still needs to be approved or rejected afterwards, and its edits are covered from the moment it was submitted.

review.title: Post-implementation review
review.help: Required to close a change request.
review.required: Choose the review outcome to close the request.

unapproved.hint: Asset edits to controlled fields that no approved change request covered at that moment. Review a flag to clear it with a note.
unapproved.empty: No unapproved changes in this period.
unapproved.reviewNote: Why is this acceptable? (for example an emergency fix, with the ticket number)

maintenance.hint: Planned maintenance that is overdue or due soon. Completing a preventive task can schedule the next one.
maintenance.empty: No planned maintenance in this period.

assetCard.title: Maintenance and changes
assetCard.delete: Delete this record? Parts used go back to stock.
assetCard.required: A title and a due date are required.

parts.hint: Stock of spare parts and the assets they fit. Parts used when completing maintenance are taken from stock.
parts.name: Name

settings.hint: Who may approve change requests and which asset fields count as controlled. An edit to a controlled field without an approved change request is flagged.
settings.selfApproval: The person who requested a change may also approve it
settings.requiredHelp: A change request is approved once this many different approvers agree. One rejection stops it.

upgrade.hint: A firmware upgrade or patch needs an approved change request that covers this asset before it can be completed. Completing an upgrade sets the asset firmware version.
upgrade.completeHint: Completing an upgrade updates the firmware version of the asset.

plans.title: Maintenance plans
plans.deleteConfirm: Delete the plan "{title}"? Tasks already created stay.
plans.planTitle: Recurring task, e.g. Quarterly PLC check
plans.hint: A task is created 14 days before each due date; when it is completed the next one is due the interval after the work. Overdue tasks are e-mailed to the asset owner.
plans.required: Enter the task, the interval and the first due date.
